artboards.title: Verdict — 15s, and the precision it demands

annotations.text:
Almost none of this is new logic.

reunion.js computes all four beats and win.js folds the outcome — both fully exercised by harness/reunion-truth.mjs and harness/win-machine.mjs, both with zero product callers. Unwired, not untested.

What is missing is a beat name, a branch, and these screens.

The one number this screen must never show: the feed count.

foldWin returns `fed`, and rrr-social-round §4 keeps it back — "the gauge is a deliberately lossy proxy, and evil losing a partner looks exactly like evil winning". A build that spreads the fold result into the payload leaks it by accident.

The Verdict pad has nothing to press — the announcement belongs to the TV, and a pad that competed with it would split the room at the one moment the night is being summarised.

The Reunion sheet is where the role card goes face-up and stays there. It is the single moment entitle.js's "NO ROW. Nobody, ever, pre-REUNION" is allowed to bend.
